failures.name: CALLER_SUPPLIED_POLICY_CAN_LAUNDER_HELDOUT
failures.observation: A byte-identical raw heldout case was copied to an ordinary path, allowlisted by a caller-built policy, and became exportable.
failures.root_cause: The policy selected by the caller is treated as a root authority without an independent canonical registry/signature binding that can recognize benchmark-derived content.

failures.name: OFF_REPO_POLICY_PATH_ACCEPTED_AS_ROOT
failures.observation: A policy JSON written outside the repository was accepted by load_trust_policy and authorized training export.
failures.root_cause: Trust-policy file identity/path is not itself authenticated; version/shape checks are sufficient to become root authority.

failures.name: CROSS_SUITE_CASE_ID_COLLISION_NOT_REJECTED
failures.observation: The policy builder accepted the same case_id in two trusted suites with conflicting heldout/dev splits, and the dev collision remained exportable.
failures.root_cause: The trust policy enforces uniqueness of suite_id but has no global case identity namespace/collision gate across suites.

failures.name: SUITE_BLOB_REPLAY_ALTERNATE_FAMILY_ROOT
failures.observation: The exact genuine suite blob was replayed at another path with an alternate family root that declared the genuine heldout case_id as dev, and export succeeded.
failures.root_cause: Suite blob identity is not bound to a canonical suite path plus canonical family-root/manifest set by an authority above the caller-built policy.
